acerca_de_mi.p1: I am a Full Stack Developer with experience developing and maintaining web applications in production. I currently work as part of the development team at the Municipality of Córdoba, working mainly with Vue 3, TypeScript, Python/FastAPI, and PostgreSQL.
acerca_de_mi.p2: I also build end-to-end projects of my own using Python/FastAPI and Java/Spring Boot, implementing REST APIs, authentication, data persistence, migrations, Docker, and live deployments. I am particularly interested in backend development and building full stack solutions, pairing my Vue frontend experience with different backend ecosystems according to project needs.
acerca_de_mi.p3: I enjoy problem-solving, learning new technologies, and taking an idea all the way from development to production. I look to continue growing in projects where I can deepen my backend knowledge while contributing a well-rounded Full Stack perspective.

stack.subtitulo: Technologies I work with across professional and personal projects, spanning frontend, backend, persistence, testing, and deployment.

proyectos.subtitulo: A selection of my production work projects and personal developments, built with various technologies and architectures.

mbta.titulo: MBTA – Municipal Administrative & Payroll Management System
mbta.desc: Government platform for managing intern contracts, contractors, municipal secretariats, budgets, and payroll settlement processes. Participated in developing new frontend features using Vue 3 + Quasar, government authentication (VeDi), PDF/Excel report exports, and progressive backend migration from PHP to Python with FastAPI and PostgreSQL.

geoportal.desc: Web platform for visualizing, exploring, and managing geospatial data. Implemented map interaction features with Leaflet, integration with geospatial services (WMS/WFS exposed via GeoServer), new REST endpoints with FastAPI, and UI/UX modernization using Vue 3 and Quasar Framework.

nomida.desc: Multi-tenant Full Stack platform to automate customer service for businesses via WhatsApp Business. Allows configuring automated responses, managing inquiries, administering conversation rules, and analyzing commercial interactions. Integrates WhatsApp Cloud API and role-based authentication.

ecommerce.desc: E-commerce platform developed under a microservices architecture oriented toward scalability and domain separation. Implements independent services for users, products, cart, and sales using Spring Boot and Spring Cloud, communicating via API Gateway, JWT authentication, and a Vue 3 frontend.

veterinaria.desc: Comprehensive veterinary clinic management system that centralizes owners, pets, appointments, and medical histories. Implements a decoupled frontend-backend architecture with Vue 3 and Spring Boot, role-based authentication, and a REST API oriented toward efficient clinical information management.

blog.desc: Content publishing platform developed with a decoupled Full Stack architecture. Allows creating, editing, and commenting on posts, incorporating user interaction via mentions and notifications. Implements secure authentication with Spring Security and a Vue 3 frontend.

biblioteca.titulo: SaaS Library – Virtual Library Management System
biblioteca.desc: SaaS web system for comprehensive virtual library management. Enables managing catalogs, loans, reservations, and users through a platform featuring role-based authentication, metrics dashboard, PDF report generation, and review management. Developed with Spring Boot, Thymeleaf, and MySQL.

login.desc: Desktop application created with Java and Swing, using layered architecture. Includes user validation, dynamic roles, and specific views. Allows user CRUD with automatic refresh.

devbloom.subtitulo: Full Stack microlearning platform for developers.
devbloom.desc: Cross-platform application oriented toward continuous learning for developers. Features personalized technical content, daily quizzes, gamification with XP, levels and streaks, favorites, history, progress statistics, and JWT authentication.
